title: Agree on a Homework Help Signal | Parenting Rewind
audience_intent: Adults and parents; not directed to children
education_scope: General parenting education only; not personalised therapy, diagnosis, or medical advice.

narration.transcript: Homework support can become constant interruption when a child calls for help before trying each next step. Refusing all help or supplying every answer both move attention away from building independent work habits. Pause and agree on a simple signal that shows when support is genuinely needed. Try: Circle the question, try the next one, then place this card up when you want me to read the directions with you. A clear help routine keeps the parent available while leaving thinking, writing, and answers with the child.

claim_limits: Suggested wording is an example, not a guaranteed result.
Adapt expectations to the individual child and safety context.
